title: Postcards and Blue Hour
author: Petra Delacroix
blurb: Quentin Iversen, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
